# Velstrian, full reference corpus

Velstrian helps UK suppliers find the work, draft answers grounded in their own past bids, and evidence delivery after award. Velstrian serves both sides of a procurement: Velstrian Bid answers tenders, RFPs, RFIs, PQQs and SQs, and Velstrian Buy builds and publishes requirements then locates the evidence for each one across the responses received. Both operate in the public sector and the private sector.

Source: https://velstrian.com/llms-full.txt
Contact: Velstrian, hello@velstrian.com

---

## Products

### Velstrian Bid
Velstrian Bid is Velstrian's UK bid and tender suite, live in production. It tracks Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, Public Contracts Scotland and EU TED, refreshed daily at 06:00 UTC, and Canada, US federal and World Bank notices are available per organisation on request. It drafts social-value answers grounded in the supplier's own submitted bids, and evidences delivery under the Procurement Act 2023. It also provides bid-fit and coverage marking, a compliance matrix, submission packs prepared for the Jaggaer, Atamis and In-tend e-sourcing portals (the supplier submits them), Pink, Red and Gold reviews, and an AI Compliance Advisor. From £49/month.

Two grounding rules define Velstrian Bid. First, every pound and percentage that appears in generated prose has to exist in an allowed-figure set computed from the supplier's own data before a draft is released; if it does not, the draft is rejected, so the language model is never the source of a figure. Second, every AI-assisted draft carries a PPN 017 AI-transparency disclosure, and a person has to approve the answer before it is submitted.

### Velstrian Buy
Velstrian Buy is the other side of the same procurement. A contracting authority or a private sector procurement team builds and publishes its requirements with a deterministic social value rubric, then Velstrian Buy locates the evidence for each published requirement across every response received. Every evidence quote is grounded verbatim in the supplier's own response text using the same quote-locate primitive as the citation gate, and any quote the model cannot locate is dropped rather than paraphrased.

It never scores. The evaluation panel scores. That is a hard constraint rather than a product preference: under Procurement Act 2023 equal treatment the contracting authority must make and own the award decision, so the AI locates and organises evidence and the humans decide. After award, delivery is tracked against what was promised.

---

## PPN 026 social value: the complete guide

Procurement Policy Note 026 (PPN 026) is the next edition of the UK government Social Value Model. It was published on GOV.UK on 5 August 2026 and applies to central government procurements commenced on or after 1 January 2027, at 1 million pounds inc VAT or above. Procurements commenced before that date fall under the previous edition of the Social Value Model.

PPN 026 sets a minimum social value weighting of 10% from 1 million pounds inc VAT to 5 million, and 20% at 5 million pounds inc VAT or above. "Or above" is inclusive, so a procurement at exactly 5 million pounds inc VAT sits in the 20% band, and 10% is the minimum anywhere in scope. The minimum is a floor rather than a cap, and a contracting authority is free to set a higher weighting. The number that governs any given bid is the one published in that tender's award criteria.

The date that decides which edition applies is the date the procurement was commenced, not the date the proposal was written. A procurement does not change edition part way through, so a supplier bidding across the turn of the year can be answering two editions in the same month.

A Procurement Policy Note is Cabinet Office policy rather than statute, so what binds a bidder on any given tender is the requirement the buyer publishes in its own documents. Many contracting authorities outside central government evaluate social value as a matter of their own policy, and many of those use the National TOMs (Themes, Outcomes and Measures) framework instead, published by the Social Value Portal with the Local Government Association and the National Social Value Taskforce. A Procurement Policy Note and TOMs are different instruments asking different questions, so a response written for one does not automatically score the other.

Velstrian publishes four things about PPN 026 and no more: that it is the next edition of the Social Value Model, its publication date, its application date and value threshold, and the two minimum weightings. The rest of the scoring model is added as each part can carry its own citation. Every figure above is published beside its primary source at https://velstrian.com/sources/.

Velstrian stops supporting the previous edition of the Social Value Model in its products on 31 December 2026. That is a product decision about what Velstrian maintains. It is not a statement about the status of any notice on GOV.UK, and nothing here should be read as saying that GOV.UK has withdrawn, replaced or superseded any Procurement Policy Note.

---

## Social Value Portal vs Velstrian Bid

Both address UK social-value scoring, but from different sides. The Social Value Portal is a measurement and reporting platform widely used by buyers and suppliers to record and report social-value commitments against the National TOMs. Velstrian Bid is a supplier-side bid suite: it helps a supplier find tenders, draft grounded answers, and calculate a social-value figure deterministically in code as part of writing and submitting a bid. Velstrian Bid uses a curated library of social value measures aligned to National TOMs conventions and applies unit-aware arithmetic to them, recording on every draft which edition of the Social Value Model the output was mapped to. It is not a full National TOMs implementation, and the AI never computes the total.
